summary: Iteration 8 — Full E2E validation of Product Variants + Banner Countdown features. Backend: 8/8 pytest PASS (bulk-import-v2, public variants, PUT replace with exclusivity, order with variant_id, order auto-select recommended, /products enrichment, banner CRUD with linked_coupon+expires_at auto-fill, flat non-variant flow). Frontend: bulkImportParser (13/13 assertions PASS including flag suffixes, discount `>` format, legacy flat, exclusivity clamp). UI: storefront product card shows 'Mulai dari Rp 15.000' + variant-chips (7 Hari, 30 Hari, 90 Hari); ProductDetail /produk/test-variant-capcut renders variant-picker with 3 pills, default 30 Hari (recommended), ⭐ PALING DIPILIH + 🔥 BEST VALUE badges visible, clicking 90 Hari updates price to Rp 50.000; OrderModal shows 'Variasi: 90 Hari' pill + Rp 50.000 + order-variant-name testid; BannerCountdown displays 01:59:xx HH:MM:SS format; Banner CTA click → sessionStorage.cs_pending_coupon='HEMAT50' → OrderModal auto-fills discount-code-input with HEMAT50 + toast 'Kode kupon HEMAT50 sudah terisi otomatis'; Admin ProductFormDialog variants-section with 3 rows editable, 'Tambah Variasi' works, ⭐ Paling Dipilih exclusivity enforced (clicking row3 auto-unchecks row2); Admin BulkImport preview parses variant syntax correctly (2 variasi badge + chips w/ fire emoji for best_value); Admin BannerFormDialog has bf-linked-coupon dropdown + bf-expires-at datetime input.

ui_bugs.issue: Still overlays /admin login on first visit (carry-over from iter7). User must dismiss before login.
React warning 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute' still logged for TEST Variant CapCut (empty photo_url). Carry-over from iter6/iter7.

action_items: (Optional carry-over) Guard WelcomePopup to not render on /admin.
(Optional carry-over) Skip render when photo_url is empty to eliminate React empty-src warning.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend variant flow is solid: exclusivity enforced on both PUT (server) and bulk-import parser (client) — server is authoritative and idempotent.
admin_replace_variants correctly deletes orphan variants, auto-syncs product.has_variants + original_price = min(variant prices).

POST /orders correctly overrides price using variant.discount_price when set, else variant.price; falls back to recommended variant when variant_id omitted and product.has_variants=true — good UX safety net.
GET /banners enriches expires_at from linked_coupon.valid_until only when banner.expires_at is empty (manual override honored). Verified via PUT test.
BannerSlider handleCtaClick correctly uppercases coupon code + sets sessionStorage + shows toast. OrderModal reads sessionStorage on mount and auto-applies.
Parser edge cases handled: ** wins over * (checked in order), exclusivity clamp on ties, discount `normal>discount` uses discount for starting_price min calculation.
